violations.ruleName: xdm.session_context_id may not be in the selected data model
violations.message: xdm.session_context_id is known to cause Cortex IDE internal validation errors on _gc_raw datasets
violations.recommendation: This field exists in the XDM schema but is not part of the selected data model on some datasets (e.g. trend_micro_vision_one_gc_raw). Remove it or verify availability on your target dataset

suggestions.message: xdm.source.ipv4 is mapped but xdm.target.ipv4 is not. If the payload has only one IP address, consider mirroring to both sides for correlation coverage
suggestions.recommendation: Add xdm.target.ipv4 = <same_value> to ensure XSIAM correlation queries match regardless of which side is searched
